description.description: Earlier feature and deployment observations belong to their recorded versions; the root checkpoint describes the current feature clusters.
Browser lifecycle guards retain current route, session and request ownership; they do not prove native framework equivalence.
The server exposes a fixed public allowlist and private API routes rather than arbitrary file or URL access.
Exact Host and Origin checks, host-only cookies and CSRF protect account state kept in server memory.
A source clone omits original ELF/pool artifacts and cannot establish live upstream configuration without separately provisioned evidence.
APK identity and trust are scoped to audited hosts; certificate and hostname verification remain enabled and credentials are excluded from logs.
Enabled operation schemas and the 176-record catalog do not measure completed features or production acceptance.
Pre-dispatch failure and uncertain post-handoff delivery stay distinct; explicit user action and current-owner guards avoid unintentional replay.
The backend derives NIK from stored sign-in identity; initial message and save data have distinct native envelope semantics.
Original server context supplies the parcel ID; the browser does not invent it from a Berkas number. This supersedes the staged-only checkpoint.
Group and item mutations have separate cache effects; local clone behavior does not establish server membership or cascade semantics.
Local post-await disappearance remains distinct from confirmed server deletion and uses a separately scoped response parser.
The dedicated Journey is wired; Tanya Berkas, sharing/download and selected inline geometry remain incomplete.
Personal plotting binds retained photo bytes and explicit submit to server-owned context; it does not waive visit checks or establish delegated instansi support.
Nine raw fields become twelve ordered multipart parts using lookup-owned office/unit/user IDs and separate application authentication. Latest QA remains synthetic.
Final create remains gated without genuine browser notification provisioning; no invented FCM token or Android-key reuse.
Initial status/method and form exist; OTP, liveness, IKD and device-bound completion remain explicit limits.
Cross-tab notices are opaque and contain no credentials. Old responses cannot clear newer sessions and requests are not replayed automatically.
The reference pin and rendered geometry are not a survey boundary or accuracy certificate.
Imported or supplied coordinates enable local comparison and do not replace evidence of physical attendance.
The checkpoint does not implement visit bypass, fabricated positioning or remote attestation.

description.description: Raw artifacts, local runtime evidence, credentials and tool environments are omitted; historical audit links can refer to unpublished local evidence.
The graph excludes analysis history, tests/fixtures, generated JSON, vendored bundles and artwork while preserving published test source separately.
The 2,520-test result belongs to the original analysis workspace with private/historical dependencies, not the source-only clone.
Fourteen browser checks including eleven DOM groups and 156 observations use injected accounts, QR, identity and transport; they do not submit to BPN.
2,488 passed with no failures; 32 callbacks are explicitly omitted rather than counted as successful tests.
Two module-level exclusions omit thirteen callbacks and exact filters omit nineteen more, including mixed implementation/evidence assertions.
Loopback publication, read-only mounts/filesystem, dropped capabilities and no-new-privileges bound local service exposure.
The exact configured Host selects the accepted origin; forwarded headers confer no trust and public/local sessions are separate.
Only named original artifacts are mounted read-only; a public source clone omits them and cannot recreate upstream configuration by itself.
PDF shape/size and session expiry checks do not verify signatures, document authenticity or production acceptance.
Dart SDK 3.12.2 and intl 0.20.2 reference with retained dependency licenses; exact APK intl release/equivalence remains unproved.
